test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: _________ is an ancient martial art that originated in peninsular India as a part of military training for warriors.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalaripayattu**____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalaripayattu is the martial art form prevalent in the Indian state of Kerala.

 
 
• The word meaning of Kalaripayattu is “art of the battlefield".
 
• It is believed to be Lord Vishnu is the founder of martial arts in India.
 
• Kalaripayattu is considered as the oldest form of martial arts in India.
 
• Kalaripayattu was used as a code of combat by the dynasties in South India.
 
• Kalaripayattu is considered the most scientific type of martial art form in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other important art forms in Kerala are:

 
 
• Kathakali.
 
• Mohiniyattam.
 
• Chakyar Koothu.
 
• Theyyam.
 
• Ottamthullal.
 
 
 
• Important art forms in Tamil Nadu are:
 
 
• Kolattam.
 
• Bharatanatyam.
 
• Bommalattam.
 
• Chakkai Attam.
 
• Devaraattam.
 
• Therukoothu.
 
 
 
• Important art forms in Karnataka are:
 
 
• Yakshagana.
 
• Somana Kunita.
 
• Jagghalige Kunita.
 
• Krishna Parijata.
